prompts: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE finished 16:9 landscape abdominal ultrasound examination CG for Hoshimi Hospital. Supplied image is ONLY an art-style reference, not subject matter: match its confident crisp anime linework, mature expressive faces, glossy structured hair highlights, rich colors and layered cel shading, polished Japanese visual-novel event illustration. Depict ordinary non-obstetric transabdominal ultrasound on a clearly adult woman around 30-40. No pregnancy or fetus. Clinician is an adult female ultrasound nurse in a PURE WHITE short-sleeved uniform, white collar/cuffs and plain white nurse cap, pale disposable gloves. Patient's chest is covered by a blouse or gown; lower body fully covered by a sheet; only the abdomen between ribs and waist is exposed for examination. One real-looking curved-array ultrasound transducer with a single cable leading to the cart, broad rounded contact surface flat against abdomen with a small amount of clear gel. Nurse has exactly TWO hands: one gripping probe, other on console, never extra hands. Patient anatomy coherent and proportionate. Monitor shows a generic grayscale abdominal ultrasound fan image with fine interface ticks, no readable writing. Calm professional clinical moment, no glamour or sexual posing, no injury, no blood. No syringes, needles, tourniquets or blood sampling equipment despite style reference. Complete opaque room background, no captions/logos/watermarks/UI overlay, no panels or collage. Variant 1: a spacious bedside medium-wide shot, eye-level from the patient's left side. Adult patient with long dark-brown straight hair lies supine at LEFT on a white pillow, wearing a powder-blue examination gown neatly folded just above abdomen, thin white sheet over pelvis and legs; her hands rest comfortably on her covered upper chest. Adult nurse with chestnut low bun at RIGHT gently scans the upper abdomen while watching monitor positioned between and behind them. Her other hand reaches ultrasound console. Patient looks calmly toward nurse. Blue-gray and teal examination room, soft daytime window light from left, slightly dimmer area around screen, tidy cabinet, mint privacy curtain. Mature face design, strong visual separation and carefully shaded pure white uniform, both faces and entire scanning action readable at 800x450.
